production.summary: Published Rules permit every authenticated user to read/write every document; unchanged by this task.

findings.issue: Global request.auth != null grants cross-user financial and profile access.
findings.recommendation: Review deployed clients and historical authority fields, validate restricted Rules and approve a production transition before publishing.

localPrototype.summary: Restricted Stage02 scope: own profiles with immutable legacy permissions; bounded own-bank reads; pre-established group read ACL; all financial writes and other paths denied. Emulator attacks passed; this score is not a production security guarantee.
limitations: Existing permissive-era fields cannot be assumed trustworthy
Financial invariants for future writes are not implemented; writes remain denied
IAM/Admin SDK bypasses Rules and requires separate access governance

validation: Rules compiled and evaluated by Firestore Emulator; tests cover create/update bypass, foreign PII, roles, ownership, bounds, schema, timestamps, groups, queries and subcollections.
